preprocessing.unit_conversion: physical signal (WFDB p_signal: (adc - baseline) / gain from the header) x {mV: 1e3, uV: 1, V: 1e6}; applied exactly once
preprocessing.pretrain_units_evidence: UnifiedDataset.h5 stores raw .mat val; Chapman/CPSC2018/CPSC-extra/Georgia headers are 1000 adu/mV, baseline 0 -> microvolts
preprocessing.resampler: scipy.signal.resample_poly(x, up, down) on the whole recording
preprocessing.window: [centre - 500, centre + 500); centre beat at index 500; incomplete windows dropped

eval_protocol: validation in fixed order randperm(seed=0), batch 128, eval mode, natural class frequencies
selection: max mean(PAC AUPRC, PVC AUPRC) on validation over all epochs
note: Most training PACs come from two patients (see prep_report.txt); results for PAC reflect very limited patient diversity, which focal loss does not address.
